emails.subject: Replacement card still not delivered
emails.body: I requested a replacement card on 16 September. The tracking page has not moved for a week. Please tell me where the card is.
emails.backend_status: Card dispatched 27 Sep; courier shows out for delivery 29 Sep.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your replacement card was dispatched on 27 September and the courier shows it out for delivery today, 29 September. We will confirm once it is delivered. We are sorry for the wait.

emails.subject: UPI paisa kat gaya, wapas nahi aaya
emails.body: 26 September ko UPI payment fail hua, paisa account se kat gaya. Abhi tak reversal nahi aaya. Complaint pehle bhi kiya tha.
emails.backend_status: Reversal credited 28 Sep, 18:05. Compensation for one day of delay due.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The failed UPI payment of 26 September was reversed to your account on 28 September at 18:05. As the reversal was one day late, the compensation due under the RBI timeline will be credited separately. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

emails.subject: On behalf of the account holder: account restriction after re-KYC
emails.body: Writing on behalf of the account holder. Re-KYC documents were submitted at the branch on 19 September. The account still shows as restricted. Please advise.
emails.backend_status: Re-KYC verified 28 Sep; restriction lifted 28 Sep, 17:30.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The re-KYC documents were verified on 28 September and the restriction on the account was lifted the same day at 17:30. The account is now fully active. We will reply to the account holder's registered email as well.

emails.subject: Disbursal date for my home loan
emails.body: My builder is asking for the next instalment. The disbursal was approved last week. When will it be paid?
emails.backend_status: Disbursal scheduled 30 Sep after the technical visit report.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The next disbursal on your home loan is scheduled for 30 September, following the technical visit report. We will send the payment confirmation to you and to the builder once it is made.

emails.subject: Voucher redeem kiya, mila nahi
emails.body: Reward points se voucher redeem kiya 22 September ko. Points kat gaye par voucher email mein nahi aaya.
emails.backend_status: Voucher issued 28 Sep; resent to registered email.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The voucher you redeemed on 22 September was issued on 28 September and has been sent again to your registered email address. Please check your inbox, including the spam folder. We are sorry for the delay.

emails.subject: Card closure request ignored
emails.body: I asked for my credit card to be closed on 19 September. It is still active and I have been charged an annual fee.
emails.backend_status: Closure request open since 19 Sep; the 7-working-day TAT ended 28 Sep, so ₹500 a day now accrues.

emails.subject: Fraudulent transactions: shadow credit
emails.body: I reported two transactions I did not make on 19 September. I was told I would get a temporary credit. Nothing yet.
emails.backend_status: Shadow credit pending; day 8 of 10 working days.

emails.subject: Property documents after loan closure
emails.body: Writing for the borrower. The loan was closed on 1 September. The original property documents have not been returned.
emails.backend_status: Documents at the central vault; day 28 of 30 calendar days.

emails.subject: Account freeze kyun hua
emails.body: Mera salary account achanak debit freeze ho gaya. Branch ne bola email karo. Rent aur EMI dono atke hain.
emails.backend_status: Freeze review opened 26 Sep; no decision yet. Bank TAT: confirm in discovery.

emails.subject: Dispute raised in August, no update
emails.body: I disputed a charge on 18 August. Two follow-ups later, I have no update. I will approach the RBI Ombudsman if this is not resolved.
emails.backend_status: No movement since 24 Aug; merchant response not chased.

emails.subject: Complaint closed without resolution, third time
emails.body: This is the third time my complaint has been closed without anything being fixed. The charge is still on my statement.
emails.backend_status: Closed twice without reversal; charge still applied.

emails.subject: Wrong entry on my credit report
emails.body: My personal loan was closed in June but my credit report still shows it as active. My home loan application is stuck because of it.
emails.backend_status: Correction not sent to the bureau; day 34 of 30.

emails.subject: Card application status
emails.body: I applied for a credit card two weeks ago. The status page says under process. How much longer?
emails.backend_status: Verification complete; approval expected 30 Sep.

emails.subject: Refund abhi tak nahi aaya
emails.body: Merchant ne 20 September ko refund process kiya. Bank mein abhi tak credit nahi hua.
emails.backend_status: Refund received from the network 28 Sep; credit in the next batch.

emails.subject: Two-wheeler loan approval
emails.body: My two-wheeler loan was approved but the dealer has not received the payment.
emails.backend_status: Payment released 28 Sep; dealer credit on 29 Sep.

emails.subject: Annual fee reversal
emails.body: I met the spend condition for the fee waiver but was charged the annual fee.
emails.backend_status: Fee reversed 27 Sep; customer not yet informed.

emails.subject: App login nahi ho raha
emails.body: Naya phone liya, app mein login nahi ho raha. MPIN reset bhi fail ho raha hai.
emails.backend_status: Device binding reset 27 Sep; customer logged in 27 Sep, 20:14.

emails.subject: Interest certificate

emails.backend_status: Certificate emailed 27 Sep.

emails.subject: Insurance added without my consent
